template_source.note: v15 is structurally isomorphic to the frozen v14 preregistration; v14 and every file it binds were read but not modified

post_hoc_rule_revision.revised_object: the frozen decision rule of results/r4e9_mask_confined_oracle_spec_20260826.md lines 59-69
post_hoc_rule_revision.plain_statement: The r4e9 result fell outside all three pre-stated branches of the r4e9 frozen spec. The lead chose 'option A': accept the layered loss of -0.0504 under convention (ii), freeze v15 = masked loss + mask-confined correction, admit all three families, and install no abstention route. This is an after-the-fact revision of an already-frozen decision rule.

original_frozen_threshold.name: confined_convention_ii_tolerance
original_frozen_threshold.meaning: confined convention (ii) gain must be >= unconfined convention (ii) gain - 0.02

measured_violation.note: layered fails the frozen convention (ii) tolerance at every measured rank, not only at the decision rank

lead_stated_revision_rationale_verbatim_: the 0.05 acceptance gate is bound to convention (iii) global_energy_rel_l2, not to convention (ii)
under convention (iii) layered improves from unconfined +0.07676510674011527 to confined +0.18953689011188593
convention (ii) masked_energy_floored_per_frame is only a training proxy, it is not the acceptance convention

honesty_qualifications.cost_admitted: the r4e9 spec's own protection against threshold drift was spent here; any later appeal to 'v15 was preregistered' must carry this revision with it

what_this_revision_does_not_change: the convention (iii) acceptance threshold, which is inherited from v14 unchanged
the sealed status of validation and test_id future wavefields

objective.name: masked_loss_plus_mask_confined_correction
objective.definition: the training loss is evaluated on mask-retained frames only, and the learned correction is multiplied by the mask before it is applied, so the correction is exactly zero on dropped frames

mask.truth_mask_role: labelled diagnostic only, never the headline variant, never deployed

abstention_route.reason: lead option A admits all three families; note that this is the consequence of the post_hoc_rule_revision above, not of a branch that the evidence passed

outside_mask_share_of_unconfined_error_e.note: share of the unconfined arm's total error-energy increase over parent that is located in mask-dropped frames; reported only where the unconfined arm actually increased total error energy over parent, null otherwise
outside_mask_share_of_unconfined_error_e.interpretation: uniform rank16 share 1.0002 means the entire convention (iii) blow-up is located in the dropped frames; the in-mask error actually fell (delta_inside_mask = -1.4748319070326705e-15) while the out-of-mask error rose by 6.592947057507894e-12. A share slightly above 1.0 is the arithmetic consequence of the in-mask term improving at the same time.

confinement_effect_on_out_of_mask_error.meaning: confinement restores the parent exactly outside the mask, by construction

mask_agreement_with_truth_mask.role: supports that the parent-energy mask is a usable deployment-causal proxy; it is not a performance claim

hypothesis_H.statement: the convention (iii) blow-up of the unconfined masked arm is located in the mask-dropped frames
hypothesis_H.honesty_note: H was directly confirmed at rank 16 on uniform only, because uniform is the only family whose unconfined arm increased total error energy at that rank. layered supplies a rank-32 confirmation (share 1.14468719912081). H is not confirmed on marmousi at any rank because marmousi never blows up.

defective_branch_label_in_source_termina.defect: the classifier in the measured run fell through to branch (b) although branch (b)'s precondition (some family with confined convention (iii) gain < 0) was false, yielding an empty family list in its verdict string

acceptance.convention_ii_status: training proxy only; it is not an acceptance convention and no v15 acceptance claim may be made under it

budget.inherited_from: v14, itself inherited from the frozen v12 config

rollback.for_this_freeze: none required; this freeze is document-only, zero training, zero weights, zero checkpoint writes
rollback.for_future_v15_runs: preserve parent and every protected checkpoint; no deletion

inherited_vetoes.note: restated verbatim in substance from the r16_dscp line; every one of these remains in force under v15

a_no_threshold_movement_toward_measured_.veto: thresholds must not be adjusted in the direction of measured values
a_no_threshold_movement_toward_measured_.tension_flag: the post_hoc_rule_revision above is a revision of a decision rule, not of an acceptance threshold. The convention (iii) acceptance threshold 0.05 is unchanged. This distinction is recorded so the reader can judge it, not to excuse it.

b_no_deployment_time_truth_in_the_mask.veto: the mask must not use deployment-time truth, including truth frame energy
b_no_deployment_time_truth_in_the_mask.v15_compliance: m_t is computed from parent frame energy only

c_no_cross_record_or_synthetic_oracle_co.veto: oracle constants carried across records, or derived from panels containing synthetic samples, must not serve as an acceptance baseline

d_smoke_loss_gate_is_not_learning_or_con.veto: the smoke loss-reduction gate must never be presented as evidence of learning or convergence

e_no_physics_or_pde_residual_framing.veto: this correction must not be described as a physics residual, a PDE residual, or deployment-time truth supervision
e_no_physics_or_pde_residual_framing.what_it_actually_is: an output-field data fit plus a feature-driven ansatz

f_no_promotion_on_smoke_evidence.veto: smoke evidence must never promote a candidate to pilot or long

smoke_loss_gate.v14_defect: the loss-reduction gate was computed across records by taking the first and last loss of the whole smoke stream, so a record ordering effect could satisfy it
smoke_loss_gate.required_v15_change: compute loss reduction per-record; taking first and last across records is forbidden

oracle_gain_constants.v14_defect: the oracle_gain baseline was a hardcoded constant not recomputed on the record being scored
oracle_gain_constants.required_v15_change: the oracle gain must be recomputed on the scored record itself

normalized_coefficient_energy_dimensiona.defect: normalized_coefficient_energy carries units of amplitude squared but is summed directly with three dimensionless ratios in the loss

peak_vram_gate_trivially_passes.defect: peak_vram_bytes was recorded as 0, which makes the VRAM gate pass trivially

rank32_minus_rank16_gain_increment_uncon.note: these three values are the +0.135 / +0.187 / +0.127 figures cited in the lead ruling; they are the UNCONFINED convention (ii) increments. The confined convention (ii) increments are +0.1287 / +0.1757 / +0.1274. Both arms exceed 0.05 by a wide margin, so the conclusion is unchanged, but the arm label is recorded rather than blurred.

rank_status.conclusion: rank is still an active bottleneck at rank 16 under every family and both arms
rank_status.honesty_note: this is a known headroom left on the table, not an optimum. Any v15 result must be read as a rank-16 result with unexhausted rank headroom.

permitted_claims: confinement removes the convention (iii) blow-up of the masked arm on the measured train records
the blow-up is located in mask-dropped frames where it was directly measurable
forbidden_claims: v15 passed a preregistered scientific gate
any speedup claim; the parent speedup is only 1.608x and the candidate must not claim 10x or faster than parent
any claim derived from training loss, sampled frames, an oracle diagnostic, or a projected trend

parent.direct_rehash_blocker: resolved: the worker session could not reach the path; the lead session recomputed it directly and it matches
parent.why_this_is_not_a_drift_finding: this freeze performed zero training, zero GPU work and zero checkpoint writes, so there is no mechanism by which it could have altered the parent; the unverified state is a measurement gap, not evidence of drift
parent.required_before_any_v15_launch: recompute the parent sha256 in an execution context that can reach the path, and stop on any drift
parent.direct_rehash_context: recomputed by the lead session, which can reach the path outside the project working directory

protected_paths_not_touched: the 16 files bound by the frozen v14 preregistration

required_before_any_run: replace the per-record smoke loss gate
recompute oracle gain on the scored record and void the three hardcoded constants
fix peak_vram_bytes so the VRAM gate is non-trivial
obtain a fresh lead authorization that explicitly acknowledges the post_hoc_rule_revision recorded here
re-verify all bindings immediately before launch (the parent sha256 was directly recomputed at freeze time and matched)
